domain: All initial entity IDs, list IDs and group references are valid
Lists are dense mutable arrays and may alias through multiple group references
Each entity executes at most one configured action, on its first nonfrozen update
Actions append, splice, replace a group list reference, terminate, freeze, unfreeze, pop or clear
Splice indices are nonnegative; out-of-range splice is a no-op
Source full tick executes with unrelated timing, weather, rage, push and battle-end dependencies stubbed
Fixtures isolate entity-list dispatch, cached list references, live length reloads, stable filtering and list identity; they do not validate full battle execution
protocol: N L G; N frozen terminated pairs; N kind a b action triples; L length+entityIDs lists; G group listIDs

actions.2: splice list a at nonnegative index b
actions.3: replace group a with existing list b

frames.id: entityID for update frames; groupIndex for filter
frames.filter: Only fresh array assignments register filtered list identities; group replacement using an existing array does not emit filter
